data.narrative:
Lunar Outpost is a Series A space and aerospace company that has raised $23.6M to date. The target operates within a sector populated by 6 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, and Planet Labs, though direct same-stage comparables with sufficient data density remain limited.

Our valuation analysis relies on a stage-progression methodology, the only approach with sufficient data integrity. Using the $23.6M total raised as a proxy for current valuation and applying a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier for Series A advancement yields an implied valuation of $47.2M. A peer-median approach was not viable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage data points within the narrow Space & Aerospace peer set; only 2 adjacent-stage peers were identified, falling short of the 3-company minimum threshold. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (sector median 26.4x across the 6 public tickers) could not be applied in the absence of Lunar Outpost's disclosed revenue.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $40M to $54M, with a median point of $47M. Key uncertainties include the lack of available revenue data, which precludes revenue-multiple validation, and the thinness of same-stage private comparables in the broader space sector. Any valuation within this band should be treated as a framework pending disclosure of operational metrics or closer peer identification.
